ex.en: We explored the city on foot all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在步行游览这座城市。

ex.en: A well-designed city provides accessible public transport and green spaces that improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 一座规划良好的城市会提供便利的公共交通和绿地，改善居民的生活质量。

tip: 复数为cities；市中心英式用city centre。

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。

tip: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

ex.en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
ex.zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。

ex.en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。

tip: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。

ex.en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们穿过街道来到面包店。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 沿繁忙街道植树可以改善空气质量，让城市街区更适宜步行。

tip: street多指城镇中两旁有建筑的道路。

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

ex.en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。

ex.en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。

col: work on a farm｜在农场工作
tip: 表示在农场通常用on a farm，不用in。

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

ex.en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

tip: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

ex.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。

col: people from all walks of life｜各行各业的人
tip: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

ex.en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。

col: live a healthy life｜过健康的生活
tip: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

ex.en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
ex.zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？

ex.en: Many cities are investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市正在投资自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

tip: many 接可数名词复数；much 接不可数名词。

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
ex.zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。

ex.en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。

col: a university place｜大学录取名额
tip: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

ex.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
ex.zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。

ex.en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。

tip: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 kind。

ex.en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
ex.zh: 我们今天买了很多新鲜水果。

ex.en: Cities can save a lot of energy by improving public transport and encouraging residents to walk.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通并鼓励居民步行来节约大量能源。

col: a lot of time｜大量时间
tip: a lot of接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot可修饰动词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 lot。

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
ex.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

tip: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

ex.en: A small bird carried twigs to its nest.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟把细树枝衔回巢里。

ex.en: Protecting trees where rare birds nest is essential for maintaining biodiversity in areas affected by urban development.
ex.zh: 在受城市开发影响的地区，保护珍稀鸟类筑巢的树木对维持生物多样性至关重要。

tip: nest既可作名词鸟巢，也可作动词筑巢。

ex.en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。

ex.en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
ex.zh: 安全围栏上发现了一个破洞，促使居民要求紧急维修。

col: a hole in the ground｜地上的坑
tip: hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 hole。

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

col: keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

ex.en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
ex.zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。

ex.en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
ex.zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

tip: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

ex.en: The beekeeper lifted the lid and inspected the hive.
ex.zh: 养蜂人掀开盖子，检查了蜂箱。

ex.en: Each community garden became a hive of activity as residents worked together to grow fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 居民们共同种植新鲜蔬菜，使每个社区菜园都成为一派忙碌的场所。

col: a hive of activity｜繁忙的场所
tip: a hive of activity形容人们忙碌活动的场所。

ex.en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 猫蜷缩在厨房的桌子下面。

ex.en: Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.
ex.zh: 根据新政策，地方政府必须在学校和住宅区附近提供更安全的骑行路线。

col: under the age of｜年龄不满
tip: under可表位置、数量或状态：under pressure。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 night。

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
ex.zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

col: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
tip: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 honey。

ex.en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
ex.zh: 房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。

ex.en: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。

tip: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

ex.en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
ex.zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。

col: treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

ex.en: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
ex.zh: 我问了价格，却没有人回答。

ex.en: Improving public transport may provide an answer to traffic congestion in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通或许能为快速发展的城市地区提供缓解交通拥堵的办法。

col: the answer to a problem｜问题的解决办法
tip: 动词answer直接接问题；名词用the answer to。

ex.en: Ten minus three leaves enough apples for everyone.
ex.zh: 十个苹果减去三个，剩下的仍够每人分一个。

ex.en: A household's disposable income is its total income minus taxes and other compulsory payments.
ex.zh: 家庭可支配收入是总收入扣除税款及其他强制性支出后剩余的部分。

tip: minus可表减去，也可置于温度前表示零下。

ex.en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
ex.zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。

ex.en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
ex.zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。

tip: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 number。

ex.en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
ex.zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。

ex.en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
ex.zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。

tip: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 number。

ex.en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
ex.zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？

ex.en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。

col: use public transport｜使用公共交通
a wide range of uses｜多种用途
tip: 动词读/juːz/，名词读/juːs/。

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

ex.en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
ex.zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

col: say something to someone｜对某人说某事
have a say in｜对……有发言权
tip: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

ex.en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
ex.zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。

col: every reason to believe｜充分的理由相信
tip: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 every。

ex.en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
ex.zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？

ex.en: Many cities are investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市正在投资自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

tip: many 接可数名词复数；much 接不可数名词。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 many。

ex.en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
ex.zh: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。

ex.en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
ex.zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。

tip: 在超市购物常说shop at a supermarket。

ex.en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们晚餐吃了米饭和清蒸鱼。

ex.en: Improved irrigation methods can help farmers grow rice while using less water in regions affected by drought.
ex.zh: 改进灌溉方式可帮助受干旱影响地区的农民在减少用水的同时种植水稻。

col: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭
tip: rice通常不可数；一粒米用a grain of rice。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 rice。

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 box。

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 bottle。

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
ex.zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
ex.zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

col: sell something to someone｜把某物卖给某人
sell an idea｜推销一个想法
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。

ex.en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

col: need to do something｜需要做某事
meet basic needs｜满足基本需求
tip: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

ex.en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期六一早去购物。

ex.en: The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.
ex.zh: 网上购物的发展改变了消费者习惯，也增加了对送货上门服务的需求。

tip: shopping作名词不可数；“去购物”用go shopping。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 shopping。

ex.en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。

ex.en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
ex.zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。

tip: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。

ex.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
ex.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

tip: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 fast。

ex.en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
ex.zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。

ex.en: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a piece of candy｜一块糖果
a candy bar｜一条巧克力糖
tip: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

ex.en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 刚出炉的面包放在厨房窗边晾凉。

ex.en: Choosing wholegrain bread instead of refined varieties can increase fibre intake and support a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 选择全谷物面包而非精制面包，可以增加膳食纤维摄入，有助于均衡饮食。

col: a loaf of bread｜一条面包
a slice of bread｜一片面包
tip: bread通常不可数；一片用a slice of bread。

ex.en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。

ex.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

col: win someone's trust｜赢得某人的信任
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

ex.en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
ex.zh: 今天出门前请给植物浇水。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
ex.zh: 获得清洁的饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共健康至关重要。

tip: 表示水通常不可数：a glass of water是一杯水。

ex.en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。

ex.en: Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗可能比在疾病变得严重后再治疗经济得多。

tip: 修饰不可数名词；可数名词复数用many。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 much。

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 chocolate。

ex.en: You picked the right key to open the door.
ex.zh: 你选对了开门的钥匙。

ex.en: Every child has the right to receive an education, regardless of their family's financial circumstances.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都有受教育的权利，无论其家庭经济状况如何。

col: the right to education｜受教育权
make the right decision｜作出正确决定
tip: 表示权利用a right to；表示在右边用on the right。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 right。

ex.en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。

ex.en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。

col: feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 like。

ex.en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
ex.zh: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
ex.zh: 春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。

tip: 季节前通常用in；泉和弹簧义均为可数名词。

ex.en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex.zh: 这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。

ex.en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
ex.zh: 学校的热情欢迎能帮助新生获得归属感，并建立自信。

col: warm to someone｜渐渐喜欢上某人
tip: warm比hot温度低；warm to某人指渐渐喜欢对方。

ex.en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
ex.zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。

ex.en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
ex.zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。

tip: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

ex.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex.zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

ex.en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
ex.zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

tip: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。

tip: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

ex.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
ex.zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。

ex.en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
ex.zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

tip: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

ex.en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
ex.zh: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。

ex.en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
ex.zh: 学校应让家长参与教育决策，因为家庭支持在孩子的学习中发挥着重要作用。

tip: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母双方。

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

ex.en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
ex.zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。

ex.en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
ex.zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

tip: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

ex.en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。

ex.en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
ex.zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。

col: grow increasingly concerned｜变得越来越担忧
tip: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

ex.en: I got a warm scarf for my birthday.
ex.zh: 我生日时收到了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Students from low-income families may struggle to get the financial support they need to complete university courses.
ex.zh: 低收入家庭的学生可能难以获得完成大学课程所需的经济支持。

tip: 过去式got；美式过去分词也用gotten。

ex.en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: People usually find it easier to maintain healthy habits when their friends and family offer support.
ex.zh: 有朋友和家人的支持，人们通常更容易保持健康的习惯。

col: as usually happens｜正如通常发生的那样
tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。

ex.en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

tip: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

ex.en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
ex.zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。

ex.en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。

tip: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

ex.en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常在晚饭后沿河散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly often report better sleep and higher energy levels throughout the day.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人往往表示，他们睡得更好，白天也更有精力。

col: as often as possible｜尽可能经常
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；t也可发音。

ex.en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
ex.zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。

ex.en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
ex.zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。

tip: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

tip: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

ex.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

ex.en: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
ex.zh: 她往花盆里填了土，然后种下种子。

ex.en: Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.
ex.zh: 集约化农业可能损害土壤质量，逐渐降低土地种植作物的能力。

tip: 土壤一般不可数；不同土质可用复数soils。

ex.en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
ex.zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。

ex.en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
ex.zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。

col: plant a seed｜种下一粒种子
tip: sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。

ex.en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

col: put something in place｜落实某项安排
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

ex.en: Thick roots from the oak have cracked our garden path.
ex.zh: 橡树粗壮的根把我们花园的小路撑裂了。

ex.en: Effective policies should address the root of poverty rather than simply provide temporary financial assistance.
ex.zh: 有效的政策应解决贫困的根源，而不只是提供临时的经济援助。

col: at the root of｜是……的根源
tip: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。

ex.en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

col: a round of talks｜一轮会谈
walk round the lake｜绕湖散步
tip: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。

ex.en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
ex.zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。

ex.en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
ex.zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。

col: oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

ex.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
ex.zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

ex.en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
ex.zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。

ex.en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。

tip: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 light。

ex.en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
ex.zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。

ex.en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。

tip: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。
note: 插画、发音与详解参考词库词条 light。

ex.en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
ex.zh: 请在这里等一下，我去找钥匙。

ex.en: Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
ex.zh: 由于当地医疗服务有限，农村地区的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受专科治疗。

tip: 等人用wait for someone；等着做用wait to do。

ex.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
ex.zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。

ex.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
ex.zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。

tip: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。
